title: Fix flickering or white screen on HP EliteBook U82 family
summary: On HP EliteBook 835/845/865 G9/G10 models, the screen may flicker or stay solid white. This is fixed by adding a specific AMD GPU kernel parameter.

steps.explain: Add the kernel parameter amdgpu.sg_display=0 to your bootloader configuration. For GRUB, edit /etc/default/grub and add it to GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT.
Regenerate the GRUB configuration to apply the new kernel parameter.

rollback.explain: Remove the amdgpu.sg_display=0 parameter from your bootloader configuration and regenerate the config.
